visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up shots show a hand holding a detached shower head part containing heavily browned filter beads, followed by a long, stained filter cartridge against a tiled wall. (2) A transition reveals a clean, transparent shower head with a white handle being held against a studio background. (3) A man with black hair and a black t-shirt stands in a bathroom doorway holding the shower head. (4) Close-up demonstration of water spraying from the shower head in fine, dense streams against a bathroom backdrop. (5) Graphic overlays appear with diagrams explaining the double filtration system while the man demonstrates the product. (6) The man, now wearing a patterned grey yukata, stands in an indoor hotel bathroom next to a bathtub. (7) Change to a studio setting where the man wears a pink button-down shirt and a black watch, talking directly to the camera while gesturing with the product. (8) Split-screen and insert shots compare used filters from different regions, showing extreme discoloration (dark brown) versus clean ones. (9) Visual showcase of different product sizes—mini travel version and long home version—along with promotional graphics for the group-buy package. (10) The man concludes in the studio, smiling and holding the product toward the camera.

(3) Sound of a plastic click as the product is handled. The voice remains clear and energetic, maintaining a high speech rate typical of social media reviews. (4) Studio-clean audio returns with prominent vocals layered over the continuous BGM. Frequent whoosh transitions sync with scene cuts between the hotel and studio. (5) The mix concludes with a direct call-to-action, the music fading out quickly following the speaker's final sentence.
